excerpt.en: A tattered old observation post circles [big_rip_planet.GetName] but there are no signs of intelligent life on its surface. Closer investigation may give us the answer to why.

texts.zh: 一座破旧的观测站围绕着[big_rip_planet.GetName]旋转，但地表上并没有智慧生命存在的迹象。进一步调查或许可以得知原因。
texts.en: A tattered old observation post circles [big_rip_planet.GetName] but there are no signs of intelligent life on its surface. Closer investigation may give us the answer to why.

texts.zh: 观测站上的所有数据储存设备都已被清空，并且所有可指向其原主人的证据也都已被小心翼翼地抹去。[big_rip_planet.GetName]上明显出了什么差错。智慧生命曾经存在的唯一迹象，就是散布在星球上的半完成的大都市废墟，似乎在建造中途就被放弃了。
texts.en: All the observation post's data storage units have been wiped and extensive care has been taken to eliminate any evidence that could lead back to its owners. Something clearly went wrong on [big_rip_planet.GetName]. The only signs of intelligent life are the crumbling husks of half-finished megacities, seemingly abandoned mid-construction, scattered across its surface and the looming holotemple in their midst.

texts.zh: 位于[big_rip_planet.GetName]轨道上的废弃观测站的数据储存装置已被清空。我们必须派人到星球上去，才能弄明白这里原先居住的智慧生物出了什么事。
texts.en: The data storage units on the observation post orbiting [big_rip_planet.GetName] have been wiped. We will have to send a team planetside if we want to get to the bottom of what happened to the intelligent lifeforms previously inhabiting the planet.

texts.zh:
尽管他们拼命试图掩盖，观测者拙劣的干预痕迹仍在[big_rip_planet.GetName]上随处可见……

证据表明，星球上原本居住着一个正在宗教觉醒的过程之中的以灵能相连的植物集体意识。此时一个被称为守门者的神秘外星种族毫无预兆地突然降临。从那时起，这个植物物种就疯狂地痴迷于即将来临的名为“灰色风暴”的世界末日。它们原本和平的信条也扭曲成了自灭的狂信。出于对一个永远不会来临的末日的恐惧，尽管反复尝试强行灌溉，这星系中最古老的物种之一还是在数月之间枯萎殆尽了。
texts.en:
For all their efforts at secrecy, traces of the observers' clumsy meddling are everywhere on [big_rip_planet.GetName]...

Evidence suggests that the planet was inhabited by a psionically linked consciousness of plantoids that were in the midst of a religious awakening, when a mysterious alien race, referred to as the gatekeepers, descended upon them without warning. From that point on the plants became obsessed with the idea of an impending apocalyptic event called 'the Gray Tempest.' Their formerly peaceful religion soon spiraled into a suicide cult. Within a matter of months one of the galaxy's most ancient lifeforms had wilted away for fear of a doomsday that would never come, despite repeated attempts at forced rehydration.

summary.text:
# 废弃观测站 / Abandoned Observation Post

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:141-198 (big_rip_system); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1101-1113; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:1992 (distar.1030); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:1073 (BIG_RIP); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2026 (distar.1031)

## 如何开始 How it starts

《遥远繁星》专属F型星系 big_rip_system（至多一个）由初始化放置此4级、全局一次的异常。

The Distant Stars F-class system big_rip_system (at most one) receives this level-4, once-per-game anomaly from the initializer.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.1030：观测站数据被清空，星球上只有半途而废的巨城废墟和一座全息神殿。调查 → BIG_RIP（60天）→ distar.1031“灰蛊风暴”：一个心灵相连的植物文明在宗教觉醒期间被名为“守门者”的外星种族干预，从此痴迷于名为“灰蛊风暴”的末日，宗教堕落为自杀邪教，最终枯萎消亡。奖励社会学研究并设置 lcluster_clue_desc_2。结果执行 pop_lcluster_event：若已遇到首座L星门且线索未集齐，有30%几率在10天后触发通用的 distar.9000“L星门见解”（另一故事）。

distar.1030: the post's data has been wiped; the planet holds half-built megacities and a holotemple. Investigate → BIG_RIP (60 days) → distar.1031 "The Gray Tempest": a psionically linked plantoid civilisation, meddled with by aliens called the gatekeepers during a religious awakening, became obsessed with an apocalypse called "the Gray Tempest" and wilted away as a suicide cult. Society research; sets lcluster_clue_desc_2. The result runs pop_lcluster_event: if the empire has met its first L-Gate and the clues are incomplete, there is a 30% chance of the generic distar.9000 "L-Gate Insights" 10 days later (a separate story).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

调查或离开。

Investigate or leave.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.1031 排外帝国有专属选项，效果相同。

distar.1031 has a xenophobe-only option with the same effects.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对初始化、异常、distar.1030–1031 与项目。树结构正确。lcluster_clue_desc_2 只影响 distar.9000 的文本。

Checked initializer, anomaly, distar.1030–1031 and the project. Tree correct. lcluster_clue_desc_2 only affects distar.9000's text.
